summary: Tested PHED admin main dashboard, Today's PHED Report page, and surveyor property search. Backend endpoint /api/phed/dashboard/today returns documented keys with list-shaped by_surveyor/recent_surveys and requires auth. Frontend renders all required stat cards with expected testids and does NOT render stat-total-connections. Sidebar navigation to /admin/phed/today works. Mobile viewport (390px) has no page-level horizontal overflow on either page. Surveyor login flow completes town selection and property search 'THS' returns 3 results each with labelled Mobile numbers via search-result-mobile-<id> selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: phed.py is very large (>2300 lines) — consider splitting into modules (dashboards, imports, surveys, consumers).

phed_today_dashboard uses string comparison on submitted_at with an ISO datetime prefix ('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00'); this only works because timestamps are stored as UTC ISO strings — if any code path stores datetime objects, the query will silently return nothing. Consider normalizing storage to datetimes and comparing with datetime bounds.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint /api/phed/dashboard/today validated; UI testids for cards use lower-cased hyphenated labels (e.g., 'stat-total-consumers-(phed)'). Surveyor login goes through /select-town before /employee/*.
